arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ ن وَالقَلَمِ وَما يَسطُرونَ
translation: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith)
Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman
And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing
And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature
And thou wilt see and they will see
Which of you is the demented

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعلَمُ بِالمُهتَدينَ
transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena
translation: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright
Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise
Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger
Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders
Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
Greedy therewithal, intrusive
It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

arabic: إِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِ ءايٰتُنا قالَ أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
translation: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old
We shall brand him on the nose

arabic: إِنّا بَلَونٰهُم كَما بَلَونا أَصحٰبَ الجَنَّةِ إِذ أَقسَموا لَيَصرِمُنَّها مُصبِحينَ
transliteration: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena
translation: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning
And made no exception (for the Will of Allah)

arabic: فَطافَ عَلَيها طائِفٌ مِن رَبِّكَ وَهُم نائِمونَ
transliteration: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona
translation: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
And in the morning it was as if plucked
And they cried out one unto another in the morning

arabic: أَنِ اغدوا عَلىٰ حَرثِكُم إِن كُنتُم صٰرِمينَ
transliteration: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena
translation: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit)
So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones

arabic: أَن لا يَدخُلَنَّهَا اليَومَ عَلَيكُم مِسكينٌ
transliteration: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun
translation: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you
They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose
But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error
Nay, but we are desolate

arabic: قالَ أَوسَطُهُم أَلَم أَقُل لَكُم لَولا تُسَبِّحونَ
transliteration: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona
translation: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)

arabic: قالوا سُبحٰنَ رَبِّنا إِنّا كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena
translation: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers
Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching

transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena
translation: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous

arabic: عَسىٰ رَبُّنا أَن يُبدِلَنا خَيرًا مِنها إِنّا إِلىٰ رَبِّنا رٰغِبونَ
transliteration: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona
translation: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord

arabic: كَذٰلِكَ العَذابُ وَلَعَذابُ الءاخِرَةِ أَكبَرُ لَو كانوا يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona
translation: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know

arabic: إِنَّ لِلمُتَّقينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِم جَنّٰتِ النَّعيمِ
transliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi
translation: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord
Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty
What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge
Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose

arabic: أَم لَكُم أَيمٰنٌ عَلَينا بٰلِغَةٌ إِلىٰ يَومِ القِيٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُم لَما تَحكُمونَ
transliteration: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona
translation: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain
Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that

arabic: أَم لَهُم شُرَكاءُ فَليَأتوا بِشُرَكائِهِم إِن كانوا صٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena
translation: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

arabic: يَومَ يُكشَفُ عَن ساقٍ وَيُدعَونَ إِلَى السُّجودِ فَلا يَستَطيعونَ
transliteration: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona
translation: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able

arabic: خٰشِعَةً أَبصٰرُهُم تَرهَقُهُم ذِلَّةٌ وَقَد كانوا يُدعَونَ إِلَى السُّجودِ وَهُم سٰلِمونَ
transliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona
translation: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt

arabic: فَذَرنى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهٰذَا الحَديثِ سَنَستَدرِجُهُم مِن حَيثُ لا يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona
translation: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not
Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm

arabic: أَم تَسـَٔلُهُم أَجرًا فَهُم مِن مَغرَمٍ مُثقَلونَ
transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
translation: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed
Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)

arabic: فَاصبِر لِحُكمِ رَبِّكَ وَلا تَكُن كَصاحِبِ الحوتِ إِذ نادىٰ وَهُوَ مَكظومٌ
transliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun
translation: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair

arabic: لَولا أَن تَدٰرَكَهُ نِعمَةٌ مِن رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالعَراءِ وَهُوَ مَذمومٌ
transliteration: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun
translation: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate
But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous

arabic: وَإِن يَكادُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَيُزلِقونَكَ بِأَبصٰرِهِم لَمّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكرَ وَيَقولونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجنونٌ
transliteration: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun
translation: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad
When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation
